subject: Term adjustment + VPC fork for HealthMatrix — provisioning & capacity playbook
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@healthmatrix.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@healthmatrix.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal + new isolated VPC + on-prem analytics clusters

Monica —

We're coming up on our renewal with Redwood and have two items that need to be part of the amendment: a) an isolated VPC fork in us-east for PHI workloads (separate tenancy, strict network isolation) and b) two on-prem analytics clusters (air-gapped) to be managed as part of our Private deployment.

High level asks:
- Extend term to 24 months (we'd like a term discount reflected)
- Deploy an additional VPC fork in us-east with separate billing/usage metrics
- Provision 2 on-prem clusters with NVMe-backed storage and access controls — we expect steady analytics load ~80 qps peak; KV cache retention 48 hours

Can you share a proposed amendment and rough pricing so procurement can review? I've cc'ed procurement. Looking to kick off a technical sync on Friday if you have bandwidth.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Head of Platform Engineering
HealthMatrix

Attachments: procurement_schedule.csv (attached separately)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@healthmatrix.com>
Cc: procurement@healthmatrix.com, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal + new isolated VPC + on-prem analytics clusters

Sara —

Thanks for the clear summary. This is doable; we'll need a short intake to pin sizing and operational details before we send a formal amendment. Quick clarifying questions:

- Do the on-prem clusters require air-gapped delivery (no outbound) or can we provide periodic sync windows?
- Expected sustained concurrency (p50/p95) per cluster and typical token lengths for analytics jobs? You mentioned ~80 qps peak — is that per cluster or aggregate?
- KMS / key custody preferences for the on-prem environments?

I've attached a short intake (HealthMatrix_intake_form.xlsx) to capture these. Proposal: schedule a 45-minute technical sync Friday 11/13 10:00AM ET — does that work for your team?

I'll loop in Aditya and Karthik to assemble the amendment and pricing options (term + committed capacity + on-prem appliance costs).

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cell: (415) 555-0132

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:25:00 -0500
Subject: FW: HealthMatrix request — capacity sketch + ops notes

Team — forwarding HealthMatrix's ask. Initial thinking (high level):

1) Offer structure:
- 24-month amendment, 15% term discount off hosted rates if they commit to Dedicated + on-prem bundle
- Dedicated private (VPC fork) with separate routing and usage metrics; two additional isolated clusters in us-east
- On-prem: two appliances with remote-managed software (air-gap option available but will increase ops overhead / support windows)

2) Capacity sizing (back-of-envelope):
- If 80 qps peak aggregate and typical 32-token responses, estimate 2x dedicated GPUs per cluster for headroom (we'll validate with exact concurrency numbers).

3) Operational constraints to confirm: maintenance windows, support SLA (proposing 4hr P1), KMS expectations, and egress allowances for telemetry/sync.

I've prepped a workbook with scenario costs and action items: HM_capacity_workbook.xlsx (attached).

Next steps: Karthik to propose pricing ranges; Neha to confirm on-prem support model + runbook changes. Monica — can you confirm the Friday sync and invite HealthMatrix's infra lead?

- Aditya
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: HM_capacity_workbook.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: RE: FW: HealthMatrix request — capacity sketch + ops notes

All —

Pricing ranges (prelim):
- Dedicated VPC fork (us-east) + 2 isolated clusters: $12k–$18k/month baseline for dedicated pool + $6k/month per on-prem appliance support (managed) — this assumes 24-month commit and 15% term discount.
- One-time on-prem appliance setup and shipping: ~$45k total (includes validated image, on-site guide, and remote install assistance).
- SLA uplift to 99.9% and 4hr P1 support: +$2k/month

Risks / open items:
- If the on-prem clusters must be fully air-gapped (zero outbound), we need a separate installer plan and longer lead time; price +20% ops premium.
- Network/topology diagrams from HealthMatrix needed to validate NAT/firewall constraints.

I've attached a short pricing PDF for the deck: pricing-estimate-v2.pdf. Neha — can you confirm support cadence for on-prem appliance + whether we can offer a monitored sync window approach (preferred) vs fully air-gapped?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@healthmatrix.com>, procurement@healthmatrix.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, vendorops@hmproc.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0500
Subject: Proposal & next steps — HealthMatrix renewal amendment and provisioning

Sara / procurement team —

Thanks again for the details. Attached is a draft amendment that implements the 24-month term, adds a separate VPC fork in us-east with distinct metrics, and calls out two on-prem appliances with managed support. High-level summary:

- Term: 24 months with 15% term discount applied to committed Dedicated capacity
- Dedicated private fork (us-east): separate billing and per-route telemetry for PHI workloads
- Two on-prem appliances: managed support (monthly fee) + one-time setup charge; air-gap mode supported as an option (additional ops premium)
- SLA: 99.9% uptime, 4hr P1 response; maintenance windows subject to negotiation

Next steps we propose:
1) Technical sync: Fri 2026-11-13 10:00AM ET — invite sent to infra and security (please confirm attendees)
2) Procurement: review attached draft amendment and return comments by EOD Tue 11/17 if possible
3) PO + DocuSign: once legal/pricing are aligned we'll send a DocuSign with pre-filled amendment (link included below)

HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-94217
Draft amendment attached: HealthMatrix_Draft_AMENDMENT_20261111.pdf

Monica Patel
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0132

Monica —

Thanks — procurement will review. A couple quick items to confirm before the sync:
1) KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key). Is that supported for the on-prem appliances and the VPC fork?
2) Maintenance windows: we want a preferred nightly window for upgrades; if air-gap is selected, we need an explicit quarterly sync plan.
3) Can you confirm the on-prem support SLA includes remote troubleshooting and patch delivery?

We'll plan to join Friday's call; I've attached the procurement schedule.

Sara Liu
Head of Platform Engineering, HealthMatrix
